text:
Type: tab-top curtains with tie-backs, pair
Use: filtering daylight and adding privacy at a window; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: lightweight white cotton fabric, multicolored fabric loops, matching fabric tie-backs
Colors: white, mint green, sky blue, bright orange, light grey
Shape: two full-length panels hung from wide tab loops in alternating colors, gathered to the sides with soft fabric bands, light and airy
Feel: playful, cheerful, bright, fresh
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel or bright accents, children's furniture; Scandinavian kids' rooms

product.name: HIMMELSK
product.description: With the curtains you can create that extra cosiness while shutting out the daylight and gaining more privacy if needed.
